title: IdentityInvitationSentPayload
description: Payload of `identity.invitation.sent` version 1: an invitation to join a partner was created and its email is being sent. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner that invited. The payload carries no email address. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that invited, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

role.description: The role the membership will have once the invitation is accepted.
